options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: the seat fee doesn't include any usage. Usage is billed separately.
Anthropic says usage-based Enterprise plans bill usage on top of the seat fee.

options.explanation: OpenAI: "No limit" isn't a zero-spend cap. A limit of zero is what stops overage.
Right. OpenAI says "No limit" isn't a zero-spend cap.

questions.prompt: Which kind of work uses the most of a plan, per OpenAI's admin FAQ?

options.explanation: OpenAI's list is about frequent, large, multi-tool work, not short questions.
A single short reply is not on OpenAI's list of costly patterns.
Right. OpenAI lists workflows that run frequently and process large amounts of information.
